_comment: The one place the installer learns which discs it supports. The recompiler's seeds, the spin-wait list, the patch list and the guest addresses in src/game are all addresses in one exact default.xbe, so each build is its own program: ntsc-u-retail is the default, pal-retail the one made with BO3_REGION=PAL (regen.sh, cmake -DBO3_REGION=PAL; config/pal/ and the PAL values of src/game/region.h's BO3_VA, written by tools/region/). Any other build (Japan, a patched or trimmed XBE) must be refused, not tried. To support another build, add an entry here AND regenerate/verify against it.
